These are the templates used on the Let's RP Wiki, grouped by what they're for. Click a template's name for its full instructions. New to templates? See [[Help:Editing/Advanced editing#Templates|how templates work]].

== Infoboxes ==
The box at the top right of an article, with its picture and key facts. In VisualEditor, use '''Insert → Template''' and type the infobox's name to get a form with every field. In the source editor, copy the blank layout from the template's page. Or start a new page with its infobox ready from the boxes on [[Help:Contents]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Template !! Shortcode !! Where it's used
|-
| [[Template:Infobox character|Infobox character]] || <code><nowiki>{{Infobox character}}</nowiki></code> || Top of character articles
|-
| [[Template:Infobox organization|Infobox organization]] || <code><nowiki>{{Infobox organization}}</nowiki></code> || Top of gang, business and Emergency Services articles
|-
| [[Template:Infobox event|Infobox event]] || <code><nowiki>{{Infobox event}}</nowiki></code> || Top of server event articles (heists, gang wars, trials and so on)
|}

== Notices ==
Put these at the top of a page (or under a section heading, with <code>small=yes</code>) to flag work that needs doing or to warn readers. Each adds the page to a maintenance category, listed under [[:Category:Wiki maintenance]]. Most take an optional reason, and all take <code>date=</code>. Full list and options: [[Template:Notice/doc]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Template !! Shortcode !! Where it's used
|-
| [[Template:Stub|Stub]] || <code><nowiki>{{Stub}}</nowiki></code> || Short articles that need more
|-
| [[Template:Draft|Draft]] || <code><nowiki>{{Draft}}</nowiki></code> || Unfinished pages
|-
| [[Template:In use|In use]] || <code><nowiki>{{In use}}</nowiki></code> || While making a big edit; remove it when done
|-
| [[Template:Cleanup|Cleanup]] || <code><nowiki>{{Cleanup|reason}}</nowiki></code> || Pages needing better formatting or wording
|-
| [[Template:Expand section|Expand section]] || <code><nowiki>{{Expand section}}</nowiki></code> || A section that needs more
|-
| [[Template:Sources|Sources]] || <code><nowiki>{{Sources}}</nowiki></code> || Pages that need clips, VODs or screenshots
|-
| [[Template:Outdated|Outdated]] || <code><nowiki>{{Outdated|what changed}}</nowiki></code> || Information that's out of date
|-
| [[Template:Disputed|Disputed]] || <code><nowiki>{{Disputed}}</nowiki></code> || Pages whose accuracy is disputed
|-
| [[Template:Needs image|Needs image]] || <code><nowiki>{{Needs image}}</nowiki></code> || Pages that need a picture
|-
| [[Template:Merge|Merge]] || <code><nowiki>{{Merge|Other page}}</nowiki></code> || Suggest combining two pages
|-
| [[Template:Rename|Rename]] || <code><nowiki>{{Rename|New name}}</nowiki></code> || Suggest a new page name
|-
| [[Template:Delete|Delete]] || <code><nowiki>{{Delete|reason}}</nowiki></code> || Pages up for deletion; a moderator decides
|-
| [[Template:Spoiler|Spoiler]] || <code><nowiki>{{Spoiler}}</nowiki></code> || Pages revealing things characters don't know
|-
| [[Template:Archived|Archived]] || <code><nowiki>{{Archived|1.0}}</nowiki></code> || Pages about past versions of the server
|-
| [[Template:Disambiguation|Disambiguation]] || <code><nowiki>{{Disambiguation}}</nowiki></code> || Pages listing other pages that share a name
|}

== Licences ==
Every uploaded file needs one, to say where it comes from and who may use it. Picking a licence on [[Special:Upload]] adds the box for you. To change one later, edit the file page and put the new template under <code><nowiki>== Licensing ==</nowiki></code>. [[Template:License/doc]] explains which one to pick, and [[Help:Editing/Adding images]] walks through uploading.

{| class="wikitable"
! Template !! Shortcode !! Where it's used
|-

|-
| [[Template:Self|Self]] || <code><nowiki>{{Self}}</nowiki></code> || Your own work, shared under CC BY-SA 4.0
|-
| [[Template:Permission|Permission]] || <code><nowiki>{{Permission|name}}</nowiki></code> || Used with the creator's permission
|-
| [[Template:Server|Server]] || <code><nowiki>{{Server}}</nowiki></code> || Official Let's RP logos, artwork and announcements
|-
| [[Template:Fair use|Fair use]] || <code><nowiki>{{Fair use|owner}}</nowiki></code> || Real-world logos, covers and artwork
|-
| [[Template:CC-BY-SA-4.0|CC-BY-SA-4.0]] || <code><nowiki>{{CC-BY-SA-4.0}}</nowiki></code> || Someone else's work under CC BY-SA
|-

== Behind the scenes ==
These power the templates above and the front page. You won't need to add them to articles.

{| class="wikitable"
! Template !! Shortcode !! Where it's used
|-
| [[Template:Notice|Notice]] || <code><nowiki>{{Notice|type=…|title=…|text=…|category=…}}</nowiki></code> || The shared box behind all the notices
|-
| [[Template:License|License]] || <code><nowiki>{{License|kind=…|title=…|text=…}}</nowiki></code> || The shared box behind all the licence templates
|-
| [[Module:Infobox]] || <code><nowiki>{{#invoke:Infobox|character}}</nowiki></code> || The engine behind the three infoboxes
|-
| [[Module:Main page]] || <code><nowiki>{{#invoke:Main page|render}}</nowiki></code> || The [[Main Page]]; its settings are in [[Module:Main page/config.json]]
|}
